info.title: qBraid Runtime API
info.description: Public REST API for qBraid's quantum platform. Submit and manage quantum jobs, organize them into batch groups, and browse available devices and their calibration data. Authenticate every request with an API key (`X-API-KEY`).

post.description: Submit a quantum job (or a batch of circuits) to a device. `data` is the created job.

403.description: No execution access to the device.

get.description: List the caller's jobs with filtering, sorting, and pagination. Soft-deleted jobs are excluded.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by individual job status. Takes priority over `statusGroup` when both are provided

parameters.name: tags

schema.description: JSON object of tag key-value pairs to filter by
schema.title: Tags

parameters.description: Filter by tags as a JSON object (e.g., `{"experiment":"bell-state"}`)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of items per page (1–100, default: 50)

delete.description: Soft-delete several jobs by QRN. Non-terminal jobs keep running and are still billed (see `stillRunning`).

parameters.name: qrns

schema.description: JSON array of job QRNs to delete
schema.title: Job QRNs

parameters.description: JSON array of job QRNs to delete (e.g., ["qbraid:job:abc123", "qbraid:job:xyz789"])

get.description: Aggregated statistics across the caller's jobs (counts, per-status/type breakdowns, cost/shots totals and averages).
A map of every job status to the number of the caller's jobs in that status.

Estimate the cost, in qBraid credits, of running a job on a device before submitting it.

The quote is a guide, not a cap. When you submit a job, its estimated cost is held from your credit balance; when the job finishes, you are charged its actual cost and the difference is refunded or debited. A job that runs longer than quoted is billed for what it used. A QPU is quoted from that device's execution history. A simulator is quoted from a fixed conservative duration, so its quote does not change with the shot count.

A device whose pricing cannot be quoted is a state, not an error: the response has `pricingAvailable: false` and a `reason`.

**Args:**
- **deviceQrn** (string): Device QRN (qBraid Resource Name)
- **shots** (integer, optional): Shot count to quote for. Defaults to 1000.

**Returns:**
- A quote with `estimatedCost` when `pricingAvailable` is true, or a `reason` when it is false

**Raises:**
- **400**: `deviceQrn` is missing or `shots` is outside 1 to 100000
- **403**: You do not have device execution permission for this device
- **404**: Device is not found
- **410**: Device is retired

parameters.name: shots
parameters.description: Shot count to quote for. Defaults to 1000.

get.description: Retrieve a single job by its QRN.

delete.description: Soft-delete a job. A non-terminal job keeps running and is still billed (see `stillRunning`); it is not cancelled.

post.description: Request cancellation of a job. Cancellation is asynchronous (HTTP 202).

get.description: Retrieve the result(s) of a completed job (a single result, or an array for batch jobs).
Retrieve the submitted program(s) for a job.
Retrieve the vendor-compiled program for a job (stored `{format, data}` artifact). 404 when none is available.

404.description: Job not found, or no compiled program available.

get.description: Retrieve an ASCII-art rendering of the job's circuit(s).

409.description: Program format not supported for ASCII rendering.

post.description: Create a batch group. Groups start OPEN and accept child jobs until closed, cancelled, or their maxTTL elapses.

get.description: List the caller's job groups, newest first. Expired OPEN groups are lazily auto-closed during listing.
Retrieve a single job group by QRN. A fully-terminal group is lazily resolved before it is returned.
Retrieve all (non-deleted) jobs in the group.

post.description: Close an OPEN group so it accepts no new jobs; existing jobs continue running.

409.description: Group is already in a terminal status.

post.description: Cancel a group and all of its non-terminal child jobs. A CLOSED group can still be cancelled.

409.description: Group is already COMPLETED, FAILED, or CANCELLED.

get.description: List quantum devices (simulators and QPUs) visible to the caller, with filtering, search, sorting, and pagination.

parameters.name: private
parameters.description: Filter by visibility — `true` for private, `false` for public

parameters.name: directAccess
parameters.description: Filter devices by direct access availability

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search devices by name, description, or about (1–255 characters)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of items per page (1–100, default: 20)

get.description: Retrieve a single device by its QRN.
Retrieve the latest calibration snapshot for a device: qubit-level (T1, T2, frequency, readout/gate errors) and edge-level (two-qubit gate errors, gate lengths).

404.description: Calibration data not found for this device.

get.description: Return the caller's qBraid and AWS credit balances. The organization is taken from the API key, which is bound to a single organization.

404.description: User is not a member of this organization.

get.description: Return the credit conversion rate, minimum purchase amount, currency, and example credit packs. Public — no authentication required.

get.summary: Get simulator daily usage and quota
get.description: Return the daily per-simulator job quota and current usage for the tier of the caller. Usage resets at 00:00 UTC. The organization is taken from the API key, which is bound to a single organization.

patch.description: Turn usage-based billing for simulators on or off for the caller. With `autoSwitchToCredits` true, once a GPU simulator's free daily allowance is used, further jobs on it run and are charged from credits at the device's per-minute price. With it false (the default), those jobs are refused until the allowance resets at 00:00 UTC. The organization is taken from the API key, which is bound to a single organization.

get.description: Return per-day counts of COMPLETED jobs for a single simulator (usage-over-time), scoped to the caller.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Look-back window in days; 0 = all time.

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: IANA timezone for day bucketing (default UTC).

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-KEY
ApiKeyAuth.description: Authenticate requests using an API key linked to your qBraid account. Obtain your key by registering or logging in at [account.qbraid.com](https://account.qbraid.com).

DeviceStatus.title: DeviceStatus
DeviceStatus.description:
Enumeration for representing various operational statuses of devices.

Attributes:
    ONLINE (str): Device is online and accepting jobs.
    UNAVAILABLE (str): Device is online but not accepting jobs.
    OFFLINE (str): Device is offline.
    RETIRED (str): Device has been retired and is no longer operational.

DeleteJobResponse.title: DeleteJobResponse
DeleteJobResponse.description: Response for soft-deleting a single job. `stillRunning` is true when the job had not reached a terminal status — it is NOT cancelled, keeps running, and is still billed; a client may offer a follow-up cancel.

stillRunning.description: QRNs that were deleted while not yet terminal (still running, still billed).

ExperimentType.title: ExperimentType
ExperimentType.description:
Enumeration for quantum experiment types.

Attributes:
    GATE_MODEL (str): Gate-based quantum computing (e.g., OpenQASM).
    ANALOG (str): Analog quantum computing
    ANNEALING (str): Quantum annealing for optimization problems.
    OTHER (str): Placeholder for other or unspecified quantum computing models.

program.description: A single program, or an array of programs for a batch submission (1-2000).

groupJobQrn.description: QRN of a job group to attach this job to.

JobRequest.title: JobRequest
JobRequest.description: Schema for job submission request body

JobStatus.title: JobStatus
JobStatus.description:
Enum for the status of processes (i.e. quantum jobs / tasks) resulting
from any `qbraid.runtime.QuantumDevice.run` method.

Displayed status text values may differ from those listed below to provide
additional visibility into tracebacks, particularly for failed jobs.

cost.title: Credits
cost.description: A monetary amount where 1 Credit = $0.01 USD.

TimeStamps.title: TimeStamps
TimeStamps.description: Model for capturing time-related information in an experiment.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard error envelope returned for 4xx/5xx responses.

code.description: Machine-readable error code (string) or HTTP status (integer).

CostEstimateResponse.title: CostEstimateResponse
CostEstimateResponse.description: Response schema for a job cost estimate

CompiledProgramResponse.title: CompiledProgramResponse
CompiledProgramResponse.description: The vendor-compiled program (`{format, data}`) stored for the job.

ascii.description: ASCII circuit rendering: a string for single-circuit jobs, or an array of strings for batch jobs (a null element means that circuit failed to render).

statusCounts.description: Count per job status (every status present, 0 when none).

avgExecutionTime.description: Average execution duration (ms) over completed jobs.

JobsSummaryResponse.title: JobsSummaryResponse
JobsSummaryResponse.description: Aggregated statistics across the caller's jobs.

JobsStatusesResponse.title: JobsStatusesResponse
JobsStatusesResponse.description: Map of every job status to a job count.

CreateJobGroupRequest.description: All fields optional. An empty body creates an OPEN group with maxTTL 3600s.

maxTTL.description: Group TTL in seconds (1-86400). After it elapses an OPEN group is lazily auto-closed.

QubitCalibration.description: Qubit-level properties; presence depends on the provider.

gateError.description: Per-single-qubit-gate error, keyed by gate name.

qubits.description: Qubit-level properties keyed by qubit index (string).

edges.description: Edge-level properties keyed by metric name, then by source-qubit key, to a list of edge entries.

creditFallover.description: True for a simulator whose daily quota is a free allowance that can fall over to credits (the GPU simulators). Once the allowance is used, further jobs run charged from credits at the device's per-minute price when `autoSwitchToCredits` is true, and are refused when it is false.

autoSwitchToCredits.description: The caller's usage-based billing setting for simulators; the same on every entry. Only affects entries with `creditFallover`.
Run jobs past a GPU simulator's free daily allowance, charged from credits (true), or refuse them (false).

shots.title: Shots
shots.description: Shot count the quote assumes. Only present when `shots` was passed in the request.

CostEstimateAvailable.title: CostEstimateAvailable
CostEstimateAvailable.description: A quote for a device with usable pricing

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why no cost could be quoted. `no_pricing_configured`: the device has no price data. `dynamic_pricing_unavailable`: the price depends on the submitted program and cannot be quoted up front.

pricingModel.title: Pricing Model
pricingModel.description: The device's pricing model, or null if none is configured

CostEstimateUnavailable.title: CostEstimateUnavailable
CostEstimateUnavailable.description: The device's pricing cannot be quoted
